how: We read the website of every Miami wedding planner listed on Lazo (61 listings, 36 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues and caterers that also sell coordination, a tent and chair rental company, a mobile bar, a San Antonio party planner listed in Miami, and a planner whose only readable page was a contact form. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Which Miami venues have you worked this year, and what is your rain and hurricane-season contingency when the ceremony is outdoors?
Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours, meetings and vendor management.
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner I hired or an associate?

picks.name: Daughter of Design
picks.blurb: Annie Lee, the daughter of an interior designer, runs Daughter of Design, was named a Top Planner in the World by Harper's Bazaar, founded Plannie and wrote Learn to Speak Wedding. Hourly consultations are available alongside month-of and full-service planning.

picks.name: It's All in the Details by Mary Beth
picks.blurb: Mary Beth is a Master Certified wedding planner in Fort Lauderdale who promises gracious precision and a clear, organized plan that stays in budget. Full planning built around what is genuine to you, laid out on the site as a simple process.

picks.name: Posh Parties
picks.blurb: Almost two decades of luxury wedding planning in Palm Beach with a concierge-style, high-touch approach, full creative direction and in-house logistics. Posh Parties has been named a top wedding planner by Brides and Over the Moon.

picks.name: Kat Saenz Productions
picks.blurb: A full-service experiential production and design studio that brings planning, creative direction, fabrication, florals and technical production together under one roof. Kat Saenz Productions works for luxury brands and public figures as well as couples, so expect a production mindset.

picks.name: Maza Events LLC
picks.blurb: Maza Events began with a birthday celebration on the sand and grew into a private-residence event atelier trusted by hotel and residential concierges from Bal Harbour to Palm Beach. Wedding planning and engagements for couples celebrating at home or in a private setting.

picks.name: Melissa Davis Designs
picks.blurb: Melissa Davis Designs is a luxury planning and consulting firm specializing in destination weddings in South Florida, with established vendor and venue relationships and a senior event producer, Bonnie Sepe, on the team. Floral design and guest experiences like spa days and beach parties are part of the offer.

picks.name: Peacock Premier Events
picks.blurb: Stacey Feldman started Peacock Marketing Group in 2008 and runs Peacock Premier Events as its luxury wedding and event arm, with an out-of-the-box style she applies to each client's vision. Based in Delray Beach.

picks.name: Linzi Events
picks.blurb: Linzi brings over 15 years of luxury weddings and mitzvahs across Boca Raton, Palm Beach and Miami, pairing creative design with calm coordination. She positions herself as a partner through the whole process, not just a planner.

picks.name: La Blanca Weddings
picks.blurb: Barbara Clifton handles day-of coordination for couples who planned the wedding themselves and need someone to execute it on the day. La Blanca Weddings tells every couple she is available from the moment they book, not just on the wedding day.

picks.name: Nexa Events LLC
picks.blurb: Full-service planning and production for weddings, corporate events and VIP experiences, with a vendor approval process that includes vetting and a trial event before a vendor joins the network. Nexa Events is based in Hollywood and works nationwide.

picks.name: Events by Nicky
picks.blurb: Nicky is a floral designer and event planner with 10 years of experience who says her greatest skill is bringing a couple's vision to life. Planning packages are itemized on the site, starting with a two-hour consultation and budget conversation.

picks.name: Florenzza Flowers & Events
picks.blurb: A wedding planning and floral design company based in Doral that starts every booking with a one-on-one consultation about your story, vision and theme, then builds a timeline whether you want full-service help or less. Florenzza puts flowers and planning on one team.
